thread:
Omar Reyes: Kickoff thread for Nimbus Health pilot. They're asking for a locked down sandbox, about 4k de-identified records, redaction-run during ingest, and a simple evaluation suite. Need plan + timeline + any enterprise blockers.
Lina Zhang: Do they require private networking or will presigned S3 uploads be acceptable for the initial trial? That will speed things up.
Omar Reyes: They said presigned S3 is acceptable for the pilot; private VPC must be available later. Also they asked for a short FAQ about temporary creds.
Nina Park (SE): For fast delivery: presigned URLs + server-side scrub job triggered by our ingest lambda. We can run a regex/PII scrub that masks emails and last 4 digits of account numbers. PHI-level tokenization needs their compliance signoff.
Theo Marshall: Pricing note: pilot consumption estimate 15k tokens/day. Recommend enabling a POC spend cap and an alert. If they want dedicated capacity for spikes we'll quote a 2-week burst rate.
Omar Reyes: Success metrics proposed by Nimbus: (a) mean latency < 700ms for query->response, (b) precision >= 0.9 on intent classification across a 12-prompt eval set, (c) end-to-end pipeline (upload->model) under 3 minutes for complete dataset ingestion.
Jared (Security): We need to answer their security checklist items: encryption in transit & at rest (TLS + KMS), IAM separation, audit logs retention, and data residency. I'll provide short answers and a SOC2 excerpt.
Nina Park (SE): I'll craft a 12-prompt eval with labels and a simple scoring script (exact match + fuzzy). Will add 3-4 negative test cases to check hallucination.
Lina Zhang: Upload options for them: (1) presigned POSTs for bulk upload, (2) STS-assume-role for a one-time uploader. Both are fine; presigned reduces IAM lift. Provide sample presigned flow and curl example.
Theo Marshall: Example presigned curl snippet to share:\n\n``\n# generate presigned URL on client side -> then upload via curl\ncurl -X PUT "https://s3.amazonaws.com/nimbus-poc-bucket/sample.json?X-Amz-..." -T sample.json -H "Content-Type: application/json"\n``\n\nTheo Marshall: If they want automated scrub: we run scrub lambda then move objects to a processed bucket with server-side KMS.
Omar Reyes: Timeline draft: Day 0: NDA+CSR signed; Day 1: presigned upload instructions + template; Day 2: ingest & scrub run; Day 3-5: prompt tuning and nightly evals; Day 6-10: stability and burst tests; Day 11: final report.
Jared (Security): Compliance blocker: Nimbus asked for data retention policy for sandbox. We'll propose auto-delete after 30 days and provide proof of deletion logs. Also need to show who has console access.
Nina Park (SE): Blocker for prompt eval: need their top 5 intents and at least 15 labeled examples total by Day 2. I'll send a labeling spreadsheet and a short guide.
Lina Zhang: Note: VPC peering or Private deployment request must go through infra and can add 7-10 business days. Set expectations.
Theo Marshall: Monitoring: enable route-level tracing, token cost per-route, and a Grafana dashboard. infra-bot can deploy a preset dashboard.
infra-bot: action: deploy-dashboard nimbus-poc-dashboard scheduled 2026-04-01T05:00:00Z - status: queued
Omar Reyes: Next steps: Nina to share eval script + template; Lina to send presigned POST examples; Jared to draft security Q responses; Theo to configure spend cap and dashboard deployment. I'll sync with the customer and confirm upload timing.
Nina Park (SE): FYI I wrote a small scrub regex: `s/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g` and `s/\b(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2,})\b/[MASKED_ACCOUNT]\2\3/g` - will validate on a sample subset first.
Omar Reyes: Thanks team. I'll send a single email to Nimbus with the checklist and link to the presigned instructions. Please flag if anything else is required.
